title: ContainerImage
description: A resolved harness container image reference. The backend tracks the latest pullable image per harness; a runner pulls exactly this reference by digest and never composes a registry, org, or tag of its own. Used as the GET /containers/{harness} response and the POST /containers request and response body.

harness.description: The harness slug this image provides the CLI for, or "base" for the shared base image the harness images build FROM.

reference.description: A full, registry-qualified digest reference the runner pulls verbatim. Recorded into a run record as environment.containerImage.
